description: List saved simulations in this workspace (id, name, level, cycle, mode, contest_id, last-modified; rows stamped with an identity also carry created_by/updated_by member user_ids). Optional filters narrow a large…

contest_id.description: Filter to sims bound to this contest_id.

level.description: Filter by office/level (e.g. president, senate, house, governor).

limit.description: Max rows to return (pagination page size).

mode.description: Filter by president modeling mode: general | dem_primary_2028 | rep_primary_2028.

offset.description: Rows to skip before returning (pagination cursor).

owner.description: Filter to sims created by this member user_id (the stable UUID from list_members) — "my sims" / "Dana's sims". Sims saved before identity stamping have no owner and never match.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the simulation name.

race_id.description: Filter to sims bound to this race_id.

updated_since.description: Only sims modified at or after this ISO timestamp/date.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: list_simulations
